item.title: Submit a Replication to FLoRA
item.description:
We aim to build a comprehensive database of replication studies across all disciplines. If you have conducted a replication study that we have not yet included, or just seen one, please submit it using the form below.

If you want to check if a replication study is already included in the database, the easiest way is to use the References Annotator
